profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer | AI Integration Specialist
profile.summary:
For as long as I can remember, I have had a strong draw towards science and technology. Growing up, I was obsessed with taking things apart and trying to understand them at a fundamental level. Over the years, I explored many technology domains and found a passion for software engineering. At heart, I am a problem solver and innovator; I have a passion for optimizing and solutions to problems that are truly useful to people's day-to-day lives.

My mission is to create and deliver high-quality, user-friendly, and scalable web applications that solve real-world problems and enhance people's lives. I lead a team of talented engineers who work collaboratively and creatively on various projects, from document processing to complex user interactions. I am also responsible for overseeing the architectural design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of the front-end and back-end systems. I am passionate about optimizing and improving the performance, reliability, and security of the web applications, as well as ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices.

For fun, I enjoy volunteering in my community to help teach the elderly and children about technology, contributing to open source projects, Inventing ways to automate daily tasks, and spending time with my family.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Department of Defense Software Development

Developed and maintained full-stack applications for Department of Defense projects using React and Django

Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to deliver mission-critical software solutions

Conducted comprehensive code reviews and merge request evaluations to maintain code quality and team standards

Communicated proactively with project managers and stakeholders to manage expectations and identify blockers

Participated in team knowledge-sharing initiatives and actively sought feedback to improve performance

Delivered features for government clients while adhering to strict security and compliance requirements
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Kubernetes

positions.title: Principal Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a team of devs in the development/delivery of client projects using various web technologies/frameworks

- Architected and implemented scalable and maintainable software solutions, following industry best practices

- Managed project timelines, budgets, and client expectations, ensuring the successful delivery of quality software

- Conducted code reviews, provided technical guidance, and fostered a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the engineering team

- Actively participated in the company's technical strategy, technology choices, and hiring processes to support business growth and success

- Spearheaded the development and maintenance of a comprehensive suite of internal tools and libraries to streamline development processes, improve code quality, and enhance productivity

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained web applications using technologies such as React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver software

- Led the continuous development and modernization of applications, such as the company's flagship Wealth Management portal, enabling clients to gain insights into their financial data
Optimized application performance through code refactoring, resulting in a 30% reduction in load times.

- Mentored junior devs and contributed to the improvement of the engineering team's processes and practices

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed REST and SOAP-based endpoints that interacted with serverless base lambda functions and traditional CRUD functionality for an enterprise-sized monolithic front-end application built in JavaScript, Node, and C# 

- Integrated functionality across dozens of microservices that relied heavily on SQS, SNS lambdas, and CRUD interactions leveraged by graphql middleware.

- Aided and led the research, architectural design, and development of a wide range of functionality across an extensive monolithic react Apollo-based front-end architecture that spanned everything from document processing to highly detailed government-regulated user interactions.

- Built out highly reusable front-end components utilizing intricate custom hooks that were thoroughly tested and scalable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a POC application that generated production-grade code from complex user interactions.

- Analyzed /Developed a range of technologies, including but not limited to TypeGraphql, RDS, DynamoDB, NextJs, Keycloak.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer II
positions.description:
- Built an internal tool for non-developers to access and update data in production databases freely.
Led Client / API  development of two new major full-stack web products, launching under budget and pre-deadline.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, Architected, and Developed ten clients / five APIs for three applications using a wide range of technologies.

- Developed two internal NPM packages equipped with CLIs, 90% test coverage, and  250 reusable components.

- Managed a team of three developers and four designers while Initiating /maintaining client relationships.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked closely with small to medium-sized businesses to develop high-quality eCommerce/ specialized web applications using React, Redux, Node, MongoDB, Express, JavaScript, Heroku, Hostgator, and WordPress

- Interacted directly with clients to breakdown complex technical requirements and architect/develop unique website UX/UI functionality using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and React.js

- Refactored legacy codebases using modernized tech such as React, Node, MongoDB, Express, GraphQL, Apollo, & Docker

projects.title: Job Harmony
projects.description: "An application resembling Tinder or Bumble that aims to connect people with potential employers based purely on qualifications. No picture, no name (initially), just a resume and proximity to the job in question. Both parties can 'swipe' left or right on each other, marking their interest and opening up a dialogue in an instant"

projects.description: A single-page open.appacademy.io clone built on Ruby riding Rails, React, and the Redux cycle with RESTful routes
